basic_details.short_information: ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health has announced 1 temporary vacancy for the Project Research Scientist-II (Medical) post. The engagement is for deployment through outsourcing agency for the Department of Clinical Research on a purely temporary basis for a duration of One Year, with a consolidated salary of Rs. 1,04,000/- (Rs. 80,000/- plus 30% HRA). Applicants must have an MBBS plus Post Graduate Degree in Obstetrics & Gynecology MD / DGO or MPH, OR MBBS with PhD, OR MBBS with three years’ post qualification experience, with an age limit of 40 Years. content_sections.heading: About ICMR NIRWoH Project Research Scientist-II (Medical)
content_sections.text: The ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women’s Health (formerly known as ICMR-NIRRCH), located at J M Street, Parel, Mumbai 400012, Maharashtra, has invited online applications on or before 06th November, 2026, for deployment through outsourcing agency for the following vacancy for the Department of Clinical Research to be filled on purely temporary basis. All applications will be screened and only shortlisted candidates will be invited for physical interaction / online interview. Shortlisted candidates will be informed regarding details of interview later. Candidates meeting of Eligible Qualification should only Apply.
